Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hub staging: West Coast node — staggered transit & contingency plan

Team / Beacon — attaching our initial manifest and site map for the Palo Alto hub (attached). We need to lock a staggered arrival window for three groups so we avoid the 09:00 peak at venue access and reduce shuttle wait times. High-level asks: 

- Confirm shuttle capacity if we split arrivals into 08:00–08:30, 08:30–09:00, 09:00–09:30 windows.
- Can Beacon provide a short-term holding area for overflow crews if flights delay beyond the final window?
- Marcus: we have two on-call leads (Rohan, Priya) potentially out — can you confirm coverage?

Attachments: jasmine_hub_manifest_v1.xlsx (xlsx), site_map_palo_alto.png (png)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if helpful.

--
Jasmine Liu
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
From: Solomon Price <solomon@travelops.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Beacon Events <beacon-events@vendors.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hub staging: West Coast node — staggered transit & contingency plan

Jasmine — thanks for the manifests and map. Quick read-through and a few notes: 

- Shuttle plan: we can support staggered windows you suggested but recommend combining the second and third windows into a single 08:30–09:15 to reduce a deadhead run; attaching shuttle_plan_v2.pdf with load calculations.
- Overflow holding: Beacon has a contracted holding lot ~1.2 miles from the venue; will charge $75/hr if used beyond the first hour.
- On-call lead coverage: we can provide a floating floor manager for the morning (subject to final headcount) but need confirmation by EOD to secure staffing.

Attachment: shuttle_plan_v2.pdf (pdf)

Let me know if you want me to hold 2 shuttle runs on tentative reserve until you confirm final headcount.

Best,
Solomon Price
Operations Lead, TravelOps / Beacon Events
solomon@travelops.com | +1 303-555-0133

Quick update — two notes from ops that affect the manifest: 

1) Rohan Mehta dropped out (medical) — that removes one lead from the 08:00 window.
2) Priya Natarajan is now on a late connection arriving 10:30 — cannot cover the morning.

We have three potential swaps: 
- Swap A: Move Maya Srinivasan from 09:00 window to 08:00 (has early flight option)
- Swap B: Pull an extra field floater (TBD) from the SF hub and split duties between 08:00–10:00
- Swap C: Marcus covers floor lead until 09:00 (I can postpone my afternoon calls)

Laura — can you sign off on overtime for one floater if we go with Swap B? If Beacon charges for holding lot, recommend approving up to $200 contingency.
